name: blvck-pm
description: Product-manager operating system — PM vault (ABOUT-ME, PROJECTS, TEMPLATES, CLAUDE-OUTPUTS), 21 routed workflows (vision, roadmap, PRD, RICE, JTBD, GTM, tracking plans, weekly updates, PRD review), an interviewed per-product agent team built from 9 archetypes, a roadmap of business outcomes, an optional dynamic workflow that researches, drafts, reviews and delivers PRDs, research syntheses, competitor teardowns and PRD reviews in parallel, and three commands: setup, run, check. Vault patterns follow ai-native-pm-os.
